kind: pull_request (unmerged fix PR treated as client-subsystem bug report; labeled bug + defer-fe)
limitations: Client-subsystem test only: no live server, no actual row-squatting race was executed; first-writer-wins + 403-on-mismatch were confirmed in server source (crates/phase-server/src/admin.rs: p2p_backup_store, guard_p2p_backup_overwrite), not exercised over HTTP.

End-to-end backup claims remain blocked by open issue #6728 on current mainline: hostDraftCode() emits 'draft-'+8 lowercase hex while the server contract requires exactly 6 uppercase alnum chars (400), and uploadBackupSnapshot() ignores non-2xx responses. The #5370 seed makes the POST fire; it does not fix the code-format or silent-failure blockers.
Only the startDraft() seeding path was driven; the periodic every-5-picks upload cadence was not re-driven beyond existing suites.
result: On current mainline, P2PDraftHost.startDraft() performs no server backup upload: picksSinceLastBackup is never seeded, so the first POST /p2p-draft-backup is deferred until 5 persist events. With the backup row first-writer-wins on draft_code (403 on mismatched overwrite), anyone who knows the draft code can claim the row before the host's first upload — the squatting window the PR describes. The PR's +5-line seed makes startDraft() upload immediately and all 59 existing host tests still pass.
